stem.text: A battery of electromotive force (e.m.f.) $10\,\text{V}$ and internal resistance $r$ is connected to three resistors of resistances $R$, $2.0\,\Omega$ and $15\,\Omega$, as shown. A current of $0.45\,\text{A}$ is in the resistor of resistance $2.0\,\Omega$ and a current of $0.48\,\text{A}$ is in the resistor of resistance $15\,\Omega$.

stem.alt: Circuit with a battery in a dashed box labelled 10 V and internal resistance r, in series with resistor R; a resistor 2.0 Ω and a resistor 15 Ω in parallel with R; currents 0.45 A and 0.48 A marked with arrows.

stem.text: What are the values of $r$ and $R$?
